import hashlib,itertools,json,sys
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter,workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES,fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
baseline=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/fq-application-gap-observations-20261122.json').read_text())
bundle=Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'))
canonical=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
root=Path.cwd();paths=('flagquantum/compiler/optimization/two_qubit_optimization.py','flagquantum/compiler/optimization/_cz_blocks.py')
r={'evidence_class':'development','source_commit':baseline['source_commit'],'distribution_semantics':'single_device_fast_path','scalability_claim_allowed':False,'completed':False,'candidate_sources':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},'manifest':baseline['manifest'],'rows':[],'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'limitations':'Inspected fixed inputs only. Shared-host quality screen; no resource or held-out qualification.'}
adapters={}
for name in ('flagquantum-ordinary-restored','flagquantum-target-artifact'):
 c=workflow_configuration(name);adapters[name]=load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options':{'sdk':c['sdk'],'workflow':name,'compiler_options':c}}))
for n,family,topology in itertools.product(WIDTHS,FAMILIES,TOPOLOGIES):
 f=fixture(n,family,topology,r['manifest']['input_nonce']);case=f'{n:02d}/{family}/{topology}'
 for name,adapter in adapters.items():
  row={'case':case,'workflow':name,'seed':11,'status':'failed'}
  old=next(v for v in baseline['rows'] if v['case']==case and v['workflow']==name and v['seed']==11)
  row['baseline_metrics']=old['metrics']
  try:
   copied=deepcopy(f);payload=adapter.execute('route',copied,11);assert copied==f
   row['payload']=payload;row['audit']=dict(adapter.audit)
   row['metrics']=routing(payload,f,None,bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if n==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{n:02d}'],0)
   assert payload['final_layout']==list(range(n));row['status']='accepted'
  except Exception as e:row.update(error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
  r['rows'].append(row)
 print(json.dumps({'case':case,'rows':len(r['rows'])}),flush=True)
 Path('/private/tmp/fq-operand-order-quality-screen-20261122.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
r['completed']=True
Path('/private/tmp/fq-operand-order-quality-screen-20261122.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'accepted':sum(v['status']=='accepted' for v in r['rows'])}))
